falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 4% above today's close and at a new all-time high within 14 days, with the VIX closing at or below 13.5 on that day.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The tape resolved as a breakout, not an unresolved mini-top. HOLD and UNKNOWN would be wrong; the correct call was bullish continuation.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 6% below today's close within 14 days, the VIX closes at or above 28, and US high-yield OAS is at least 50 bps wider than today.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The decline exceeds a June-2019-style mini-top and confirms a risk-off break. The mini-top pattern match, moderate blowoff read, and HOLD/UNKNOWN call would all be wrong.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 80 within 14 days, or the S&P 500 logs 5 consecutive all-time-high closes with 14-day RSI at or above 78.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The setup is a confirmed blowoff, not an ambiguous phase with a moderate score of 56. UNKNOWN phase and HOLD would be invalidated in favor of a blowoff-top call.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
